_comment: Single source of truth for the all-category issue models. Each class maps to a taxonomy subcategory (backend/ai/data/taxonomy.json). Change a mapping here, re-run export, and the backend follows. 'background' means: a normal street / nothing to report / not a civic photo.

prompts.pothole: a photo of a pothole in a road
prompts.garbage: a photo of a pile of garbage or litter on a street
prompts.drain_sewage: a photo of a blocked or overflowing drain or sewage on a street
prompts.waterlogging: a photo of a flooded road with standing water
prompts.streetlight: a photo of a damaged or broken street light pole
prompts.fallen_tree: a photo of a fallen tree or broken branch on a road
prompts.footpath_damage: a photo of a broken or damaged footpath or sidewalk
prompts.damaged_sign: a photo of a damaged or broken road sign
prompts.background: a photo of an ordinary clean street with nothing wrong

detector._comment: Box detector only for issues where position matters. 'pothole' is kept as a class so the model learns not to confuse it, but the backend lets the dedicated pothole detector own ROAD.POTHOLE.
